name: arbiter
title: Fair N-client arbiter, clocked and reactive: at most one grant, only to a requester, someone whenever anyone requests, and a client that requests N cycles in a row is granted within them

references.note: A registered mask round-robin (own code): the lowest requester of req & mask wins, else the lowest requester; the mask is the thermometer above the last grant. Proved for every N >= 1 (reference/rr_mask.lean: the agreement design.sem N = rrD N, the comb settle and the clock step in closed form, the rank model with the cyclic distance from the mask's edge as the rank). The real-world candidate, OpenTitan prim_arbiter_tree behind an output register (tests/arbiter/designs/arbiter_ot.sv, Apache-2.0), is the next reference once ls-sv instantiates generate-local declarations (README.md (l)).
